candidates.source_evidence: GitHub branch authority: refs/heads/main at aa319f6c86517cb95aabfae8656277da62c3ead5; upstream README documents 3D room FDTD, multithreaded CPU, CUDA, voxelization and frequency-dependent impedance boundaries.
candidates.redistribution_notes: Pinned source carries MIT license. Transitive dependencies and any modified/redistributed binaries remain separately auditable at packaging time.
candidates.windows_packaging_notes: Upstream README explicitly targets Linux and uses make/HDF5 for C/CUDA builds. R100B must prove or reject a maintained native-Windows/portable adapter path before this candidate can pass the Windows hard gate.
notes: FDTD-first is evaluation order only; this entry is not a production selection.
CPU correctness is evaluated first. CUDA is optional acceleration and cannot be a correctness dependency.
Portal continuity is not claimed from upstream documentation and therefore is not in probe_capabilities.

notes: Acts as the primary independent wave reference/production alternative in R100B.
